title: Block flow per mode
units: CSS px relative to the container border box; results[mode][dir][dprN]; "=dpr1" means identical to the DPR 1 entry; an element without computed and specified has the DPR 1 entry's

b1-fixed-children.note: three blocks with fixed width and height

b1-auto-inline.note: blocks with auto inline size stretch to the container inline size

b1-logical-sizes.note: inline-size and block-size map to the physical axes of the mode

b1-margin-collapse.note: block-axis margins collapse between siblings; inline-axis margins do not

b1-physical-margins.note: physical margins on all four sides of a child

b1-margin-auto.note: auto inline-axis margins centre a fixed inline size; auto block-axis margins are zero

b1-percent.note: percent width, height, margin and padding against the container

b1-auto-block-size.note: container auto block size: sum of child block sizes

b1-min-max.note: min and max on both axes

b1-text-paragraphs.note: two text paragraphs wrap at the container inline size

b1-empty-collapse-through.note: an empty child collapses its block-axis margins through

b1-inline-block-children.note: inline-block children flow in lines along the inline axis
